reconstructed_captions.24: The sewing machine stitches a straight line through the layers of black fabric.
reconstructed_captions.25: A close-up view of the needle and thread creating a seam on the black fabric.
reconstructed_captions.26: The hands pivot the fabric to sew around a corner.
reconstructed_captions.27: The sewing machine completes the seam, and the hands guide the fabric away.
reconstructed_captions.28: A pair of small scissors is used to snip the excess threads from the seam.
reconstructed_captions.29: A piece of black leather is placed on the wooden cutting mat.
reconstructed_captions.30: A hand uses a metal tool, an awl, to mark a point on the leather.
reconstructed_captions.31: A hand holds a hole punch tool vertically over the marked spot on the leather.
reconstructed_captions.32: A mallet is used to strike the top of the hole punch, creating a clean hole in the leather.
reconstructed_captions.33: The tool is removed, revealing a small, perfectly round hole in the black leather.
reconstructed_captions.34: A second piece of black leather is aligned with the first piece.
reconstructed_captions.35: The hole punch is used again to create a matching hole in the second piece of leather.
reconstructed_captions.36: A hand inserts the post of a metal rivet through the aligned holes of both leather pieces.
reconstructed_captions.37: The cap of the rivet is placed on top of the post on the other side of the leather.
reconstructed_captions.38: A hand places a rivet setting tool over the cap of the rivet.
